answer.verdict: SQRT.S fd,ft is fixed and tested; all 191 .text sites encode fs=0 so the old sqrt(fs) was sqrt(0). Macro VDIV/VSQRT use the right fsf/ftf. Macro VRSQRT still drops fs[fsf], but all 6 sites are vf0.w so a positive ft.w already matches 1/sqrt. The mismatches that actually run in Tekken 4 are CVT.W.S rounding (497, zero CTC1), VCLIP side-bits swapped (35 ops, all 21 CFC2.CLIP read that result), and macro FMAC never writing vu0_mac_flags (4 CFC2.MAC, all after macro ALU, none after VCALLMS).

facts.c: .text window 0x180080-0x2A91F8 holds 304222 words of the one executable PT_LOAD (vaddr 0x180080, filesz 1940968). Post-.text words in that LOAD are data: cop1_fmt_other, illegal BC, and the extra sqrt.s are gone once the window is applied.

sqrt.s (COP1.S func 0x04) count in .text is 191 and every one has fs=0. rsqrt.s (func 0x16) is 58. div.s 617. cvt.w.s (func 0x24) 497. COP1.W func 0x20 (CVT.S.W) 992 and no other W func. trunc/round/ceil/floor.w.s are 0. c.olt.s 1111, c.ole.s 245, c.eq.s 208. cfc1 and ctc1 are 0. bc1 rt is only 0/1/2/3 (848/245/183/275).
Translator SQRT.S writes fd from FPU_SQRT_S(ft). Test builds fd=2,fs=3,ft=4 and expects ctx->f[2] = FPU_SQRT_S(ctx->f[4]).

PCSX2 SQRT_S uses _Ft_ (bits 20-16): +/-0 keeps the sign bit, a negative sets I|SI (0x00020000|0x40) and stores sqrt(fabs). Field macros _Ft_/_Fs_/_Fd_ match the translator extract at fpu_translator.cpp:20-23.
RSQRT.S emitter is fd = FPU_RSQRT_S(fs, ft). Helper is fs/sqrt(|ft|); a zero ft yields sign(fs)|0x7FFFFFFF. PCSX2 RSQRT_S on zero ft uses sign of ft and posFmax 0x7F7FFFFF and sets D|SD.

PCSX2 COP1.S table: 0x04 SQRT_S, 0x16 RSQRT_S, 0x24 CVT_W, 0x30 C_F, 0x32 C_EQ, 0x34 C_LT, 0x36 C_LE. Slots 0x0C-0x0F and 0x38-0x3F are COP1_Unknown. COP1.W 0x20 is CVT_S. Game c.olt.s is func 0x34, which this table calls C_LT; both do a<b for finite values.

FPU_CVT_W_S is (int32_t)nearbyintf. PCSX2 CVT_W truncates with (s32) when exp<=0x4E800000 and saturates to 0x7fffffff / 0x80000000. cpuReset sets fprc[31]=0x01000001 (RM=chop). .text has 0 CTC1, so nothing in the game selects round-nearest.

FPU_CVT_S_W is (float)(int32_t), same as PCSX2 CVT_S. MADD.S is ACC+fs*ft. ADDA/SUBA/MULA/MADDA/MSUBA write ACC only. Compares and BC1 use fcr31 bit 23. BC1F/FL test the bit clear, BC1T/TL test it set.
DIV.S sets fcr31 bit 0x100000 when ft==0.0f. PCSX2 checkDivideByZero sets D|SD (0x00010000|0x20) or I|SI and returns sign-xor|posFmax. No CFC1 in .text, so the flag bit is unread.
ABS.S/NEG.S/MAX.S/MIN.S do not clear cause O|U. PCSX2 ABS_S/NEG_S/MAX_S/MIN_S call clearFPUFlags(O|U). Counts: abs.s 128, neg.s 354, max.s 1, min.s 2. Unread without CFC1.

Project FPU clamp to +/-0x7FFFFFFF, exp0 flush, exp255 kept as a finite value, is intentional and cited to ps2autotests tests/cpu/ee_fpu. PCSX2 fpuDouble maps exp 255 to 0x7F7FFFFF. Separate from the SQRT.S operand bug.

COP2 dest=(raw>>21)&15 with X=bit24. fsf=(raw>>21)&3 and ftf=(raw>>23)&3 are stored for VDIV/VRSQRT (ftf also for VSQRT). Same bits as PCSX2 _X/_Y/_Z/_W/_Fsf_/_Ftf_. Broadcast bc is function&3 and _MM_SHUFFLE(bc,bc,bc,bc). _mm_set_epi32 puts dest X on lane 0.

Macro VDIV is fs[fsf]/ft[ftf], or 0 if ft==0. .text n=30, every one fs=0 and fsf=3 (numerator vf0.w=1); (fsf,ftf)=(3,3) x23 and (3,0) x7. PCSX2 _vuDIV on ft==0 writes sign-xor|0x7F7FFFFF and status 0x10 (0/0) or 0x20 (x/0).
Macro VSQRT is sqrt(max(0, ft[ftf])). n=27, ftf y=24, w=2, x=1. PCSX2 _vuSQRT is sqrt(fabs(ft)) and status 0x10 if ft<0.

Macro VRSQRT ignores fs and fsf: Q = ft>0 ? 1/sqrt(ft[ftf]) : 0. Decoder does record fsf. n=6, all fs=0, fsf=3, ftf=3 (vf0.w / ft.w) at 0x1938b0, 0x1938fc, 0x1d55e8, 0x1d578c, 0x1d6e78, 0x1d6ec4. PCSX2 _vuRSQRT is fs[fsf]/sqrt(fabs(ft[ftf])) with the zero-ft cases at VUops.cpp:978-999.

VU1 interpreter divOp/sqrtOp/rsqrtOp and clipOp already use fs/fsf/ft/ftf, fabs, and the PCSX2 clip bit order. PS2_VSQRT/PS2_VRSQRT macros are  sqrtf and 1/sqrtf and have no callers. The macro translator inlines and does not call them.

VCLIP packs lt (x<-w) into bit 0 and gt (x>+w) into bit 1, and uses the raw broadcast w, not fabs. PCSX2 _vuCLIP bit 0x01 is x>+|w| and bit 0x02 is x<-|w| (denormal w forced to 0x007fffff). Project VU1 clipOp matches PCSX2. VCLIPw bc is w because VU0_S2_VCLIPw=0x1F so function&3=3.

vclipw n=35. cfc2.clip n=21. Every CFC2.CLIP is 5 to 15 instructions after a macro VCLIPw (first pair 0x18ed08 then 0x18ed1c). None of those reads is preceded by VCALLMS. The swapped bits are what the game loads.

vu0_mac_flags is stored only by the runtime seed (0) and the VU0-micro context copy. CFC2 MAC reads it (vu_translator.cpp:43). No macro emitter writes it. cfc2.mac n=4: 0x191a80 after VADD, 0x191b5c two instructions after VADD, 0x1938d0 five instructions after VOPMSUB (sequence vrsqrt/vopmula/vopmsub), 0x1d6e98 the same pattern. PCSX2 applyBinaryMACOp and _vuOPMSUB call VU_MACx_UPDATE.

cfc2.status n=3 (0x293b8c, 0x293bec, 0x293c60), two of them a few instructions after CTC2 status plus VSUBs. They are not readers of VDIV/VSQRT status. cfc2.vpu_stat n=3 with no prior COP2 in the 80-instruction window. bc2 n=0. BC2 would test vu0_status bit 0; PCSX2 CP2COND is VPU_STAT>>8.
Q-event scan: 63/63 Q writes are followed by VWAITQ before the next Q read or Q write. VWAITQ is emitted as a comment because Q is written immediately. No observed early Q read.

VOPMULA and VOPMSUB shuffles are (fs.y*ft.z, fs.z*ft.x, fs.x*ft.y), matching _vuOPMULA/_vuOPMSUB. All 13+13 sites use dest 0xE (xyz), so W is left alone, matching PCSX2 which never writes ACC.w or fd.w.
VFTOI0 n=15, VFTOI4 n=25. Emitter is _mm_cvttps_epi32 with no saturation. PCSX2 floatToInt returns 0x7fffffff for a positive value whose exp>=0x4F000000. VU1 ftoi already saturates.

VCALLMS masks the immediate to 9 bits (helpers.cpp:154). .text n=8, immediates 0,0,0,0,0,0,19,15, all <=511, so the mask does not change the target. PCSX2 uses (code>>6)&0x7FFF. VCALLMSR n=0; its emitter reads vi[fs], PCSX2 uses CMSAR0.

.text fd==0 special1 writes, ft==0 unary writes, vi0 integer dests, LQC2 rt==0, QMTC2 rd==0, VSQI, VSQD, VLQI, VILWR, VRNEXT, VRGET, VRINIT, VRXOR, and BC2 are all 0. QMFC2 n=21 of which 10 read vf0; nothing in .text writes vf0 on the macro path.

PCSX2 LQI writes VF[ft] from VI[fs] then increments fs; SQI stores VF[fs] through VI[ft] then increments ft. The macro emitters swap the SQI/SQD roles and address VU memory as EE RAM with mask 0x3FF. Those ops are absent from .text.

fix.change: n=497 cvt.w.s, 0 trunc.w.s, 0 ctc1. Before: (int32_t)nearbyintf(fs) into fd. After: chop toward 0, and if exp>0x4E800000 saturate to 0x7fffffff (positive) or 0x80000000. PCSX2 FPU.cpp:254-257; reset RM is chop at R5900.cpp:72. Test to add in ps2_float_semantics_tests.cpp: FPU_CVT_W_S(1.9f)==1, FPU_CVT_W_S(-1.9f)==-1, bit pattern of FPU_CVT_W_S(2147483648.0f)==0x7fffffff. No test covers CVT.W.S today.

n=35 vclipw, n=21 cfc2.clip, every read is 5-15 instructions after a macro VCLIPw (0x18ed08->0x18ed1c and twenty more). Before: bit0=x<-w, bit1=x>+w, raw w. After: bit0=x>+fabs(w), bit1=x<-fabs(w), same for y at 0x04/0x08 and z at 0x10/0x20, then clip=(clip<<6)|bits masked to 24 bits. PCSX2 VUops.cpp:909-924. Same formula already in ps2_vu1_native.h:501-512. Test: fs=(2,0,0,*), ft.w=1 -> clip bit 0x01 set and 0x02 clear; ft.w=-1 -> same bits. No VU test covers VCLIP.

n=4 cfc2.mac, all after macro ALU and none after VCALLMS. Two (0x1938d0, 0x1d6e98) are 5 instructions after VOPMSUB in a vrsqrt/vopmula/vopmsub block; 0x191b5c is 2 instructions after VADD. Before: vu0_mac_flags stays 0 (ps2_runtime.cpp:208) or whatever the last micro returned. After: each macro FMAC/MADD/OPMSUB/OPMULA writes vu0_mac_flags the way VU_MACx_UPDATE does (VUops.cpp:534 and 866) and updates vu0_status the way VU_STAT_UPDATE does. fd==0 still updates flags and must not write vf0 (.text fd==0 count is already 0). Test: VADD of -1 into a live fd, then CFC2 MAC sign bit set; VOPMSUB of a negative x lane then CFC2 MAC != 0. cfc2.status n=3 is a weaker consumer (two follow CTC2).

n=40 (vftoi0 15, vftoi4 25; vftoi12/15 absent). Before: _mm_cvttps_epi32, which yields 0x80000000 for a finite float >=2^31. After: positive overflow -> 0x7fffffff, negative overflow -> 0x80000000, as PCSX2 floatToInt (VUops.cpp:877-887). VU1 path at ps2_vu1_native.h:490-494 already does this. Test: VFTOI0 of 2147483648.0f -> 0x7fffffff; VFTOI4 of 134217728.0f (16*2^27) -> 0x7fffffff.

n=30 vdiv, fields already correct, every numerator is vf0.w. Before: ft==0 yields Q=0, and a huge ratio can be a host Inf; status untouched. After: ft==0 -> sign(fs xor ft)|0x7F7FFFFF and status 0x10 if fs==0 else 0x20; otherwise clamp exp 255 to 0x7F7FFFFF. PCSX2 VUops.cpp:931-955. Test: 1/0 -> 0x7F7FFFFF, -1/0 -> 0xFF7FFFFF, 0/0 -> 0x7F7FFFFF with status 0x10. Latent on this ELF unless a divisor is 0; the 3 CFC2.STATUS sites do not follow VDIV.

n=27 vsqrt, ftf already correct (y=24, w=2, x=1). Before: sqrt(max(0,ft)) so a negative becomes 0 and no status. After: sqrt(fabs(ft[ftf])) and status 0x10 when ft<0. PCSX2 VUops.cpp:958-967. Test: ft.y=-4, ftf=1 -> Q=2 and status bit 0x10. Latent unless that component is negative.

n=6 vrsqrt, all fs=0 fsf=3 ftf=3, so a positive ft.w already equals 1/sqrt. Before: Q=(ft>0)?1/sqrt(ft):0, fs/fsf ignored. After: fs[fsf]/sqrt(fabs(ft[ftf])) with the zero-ft cases in PCSX2 VUops.cpp:970-1011 (x/0 -> signed 0x7F7FFFFF and status 0x20; 0/0 -> signed 0 and status 0x30). Test must use fs!=0 (Q=4/sqrt(16)=1 when fsf/ftf differ); keep the 6 Tekken encodings as a regression that vf0.w still yields 1/sqrt. Do not change ps2_vu1_native.h rsqrtOp.

n=617 div.s, n_cfc1=0 so this cannot change a GPR on the current ELF. Before: ft==0.0f sets fcr31|=0x100000 (bit 20). After: set D|SD (0x00010000|0x00000020) when the dividend is nonzero, else I|SI (0x00020000|0x40), matching PCSX2 DIV_S at FPU.cpp:260-261. Numeric result stays on ps2_fdiv (see contra). Test: after DIV.S of 1/0, (fcr31 & 0x00010020)==0x00010020.

n=abs.s 128, neg.s 354, max.s 1, min.s 2, and 0 CFC1 readers. Before: no fcr31 update; MAX/MIN are std::max/std::min. After: clear cause O|U (0xC000) as PCSX2 ABS_S/NEG_S/MAX_S/MIN_S (FPU.cpp:185-187, 285-287, 334-336). std::max(-0,+0) can return -0; PCSX2 fp_max returns +0. Low: one max.s at 0x24a4d4. Test: ABS.S then (fcr31 & 0xC000)==0; max(-0,+0) bits == 0.

n=0 in .text for VSQI, VSQD, VLQI, VILWR, VISWR, VRNEXT, VCALLMSR, BC2. Still wrong if a later overlay uses them. VSQI/VSQD swap fs/ft versus PCSX2 VUops.cpp:1203-1226 (store VF[fs] via VI[ft]). VLQI/ILWR* use EE RAM and mask 0x3FF instead of VU0 mem. VCALLMSR reads vi[rd]; PCSX2 COP2.cpp:22-25 uses CMSAR0. VCALLMS 9-bit mask (helpers.cpp:154) does not change the 8 real immediates (max 19) but a value >511 would. BC2 tests vu0_status&1; PCSX2 COP2.cpp:11 tests VPU_STAT bit 8. Test each with a one-instruction emitter check; do not expect a Tekken hit from the current .text census.

contra: ps2_fsqrt maps both zeros to +0 and sqrt of a negative to the positive root with no I flag (macros.h:241-246). ps2_float_semantics_tests.cpp:176-178 locks sqrt(-0)=+0 and sqrt(-16)=4. PCSX2 SQRT_S (FPU.cpp:362-366) keeps the sign of zero and sets I|SI on a negative. 0 CFC1 in .text, so the flag is unread. Do not flip the helper to match PCSX2 without re-checking ps2autotests.

ps2_frsqrt on a zero radicand uses the sign of fs and magnitude 0x7FFFFFFF (macros.h:249-253). Tests at ps2_float_semantics_tests.cpp:168-171 require that and ignore the sign of ft. PCSX2 RSQRT_S (FPU.cpp:343-345) uses the sign of ft and posFmax 0x7F7FFFFF plus D|SD. Operand order fs,ft is already correct.

FPU add/mul/div/sqrt saturate at 0x7FFFFFFF and treat exp 255 as finite (macros.h:143-159), on purpose, against ps2autotests. PCSX2 fpuDouble clamps exp 255 to 0x7F7FFFFF (FPU.cpp:12 and the fpuDouble switch). That is a numeric model difference, not an operand-field bug, and it is not what made SQRT.S return 0.

Game compares are func 0x34/0x36/0x32 (1111/245/208). PCSX2's names at those indices are C_LT/C_LE/C_EQ (R5900OpcodeTables.cpp:624). The translator cases are C_OLT/C_OLE/C_EQ and the comparison for a finite pair is the same. Func 0x3C (translator C_LT) does not occur.

VOPMULA and VOPMSUB dest is 0xE on all 13+13 sites, so the dest-mask blend does not write W. PCSX2 never writes ACC.w or OPMSUB.w (VUops.cpp:841-869). The xyz shuffle already matches. The live OPMSUB bug is the missing MAC flag, not the product.
VU1 clipOp/divOp/sqrtOp/rsqrtOp (ps2_vu1_native.h:501-557) already follow PCSX2 on fields, fabs, and signed max. Patching those to 'fix' the macro translator would be wrong.
Whole-LOAD sqrt.s was 192 because one encoding sits past 0x2A91F8. .text is 191, all fs=0, which matches the earlier 191. VSQI/VSQD/VCALLMSR/BC2 hits in the unfiltered scan were also past .text.
checks: python -I logs/grok/fpu_cop2_count.py after the .text guard: exec_words 485242, in_text_range 304222, sqrt.s 191 fs_hist {0:191}, cvt.w.s 497, vclip 35, vdiv 30, vsqrt 27, vrsqrt 6 all fs0/fsf3/ftf3, q_gap {wait_before_read:63}, cfc1 empty, bc2 empty, fd0_writes empty.

python -I logs/grok/fpu_cfc2_ctx.py: 21 CFC2.CLIP each follow VCLIPw within 15 instructions; 4 CFC2.MAC follow VADD or VOPMSUB; 8 VCALLMS immediates are 0 or 15 or 19; opmula_dest and opmsub_dest are {14:13}.

Read fpu_translator.cpp, vu_translator.cpp:1-335, vu_translation_helpers.cpp VDIV/VSQRT/VRSQRT/VOPMSUB/VOPMULA/VFTOI/VCALLMS, macros.h:143-257 and 836-873, r5900_decoder.cpp:850-883, control_flow_emitter.cpp:429-444, ps2_vu1_native.h:490-557, ps2_float_semantics_tests.cpp:163-230.
Fetched PCSX2 master FPU.cpp, VUops.cpp, COP2.cpp, R5900.cpp cpuReset, R5900OpcodeTables.cpp tbl_COP1_S/W. No build, no game run, no repo edit.
open: BC1FL/BC1TL/BC2FL/BC2TL delay-slot nullification is detected in control_flow_emitter.cpp but the delay instruction was not compared to PCSX2.

Q is written at the DIV/SQRT/RSQRT instruction and VWAITQ is a comment. The Q-event stream shows a wait before every read (63/63), so an early Q value is not consumed. A stall shorter than the hardware FDIV latency is still possible if something reads Q by a path the scan did not call a Q-read.
VU_MACx_UPDATE / VU_STAT_UPDATE bit layout lives in VUops.h, which was not fetched. The missing store is confirmed; the exact bit positions to write were not copied from that header.

The 21 clip readers' bit masks were not disassembled. Each pair's OR is invariant when w>0, so a test that only checks 'either side' survives the swap; a test of bit 0 versus bit 1 does not. Negative w breaks the OR too, because the translator does not take fabs.
VSQRT negative and VDIV zero are not proven to occur at the 27 and 30 sites. No CFC2.STATUS follows those ops.
Macro vf0/vi0 hardwire and the SQI/LQD/ILW/R-unit/BC2/VCALLMSR bugs have n=0 in .text. An overlay outside 0x180080-0x2A91F8 was not decoded.
